claims.quote: The galaxy plec, Leporacanthicus galaxias (L029), is a suckermouth catfish from the Amazon, Tocantins and other river basins in Brazil.
Type locality: Rio Tocantins, Lagoa em frenta a Jacobal, Pará State, Brazil
